+def validate_in625_screening_admission(snapshot=None):
+    """Admit only the pinned IN625 evidence for bounded enthalpy screening.
+
+    This checks identity, cited source locators, model inputs, scope, and the
+    content digest. It does not validate the constitutive model experimentally
+    or admit a full transient property table.
+    """
+    candidate = in625_lpbf_thermal_snapshot() if snapshot is None else snapshot
+    if not isinstance(candidate, dict):
+        raise ValueError("IN625 screening evidence must be an object")
+
+    expected = in625_lpbf_thermal_snapshot()
+    supplied = dict(candidate)
+    revision = supplied.pop("materialRevisionSha256", None)
+    payload = json.dumps(supplied, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
+                         ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
+    computed_revision = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
+    if revision != computed_revision:
+        raise ValueError("IN625 screening evidence content digest mismatch")
+    if candidate != expected:
+        raise ValueError("IN625 screening evidence does not match the pinned source scope")
+
+    return {
+        "accepted": True,
+        "scope": "bounded-fusion-enthalpy-screening",
+        "materialId": "in625",
+        "materialRevisionSha256": revision,
+        "source": SABAU_URL,
+        "sourceLocators": dict(expected["sourceLocators"]),
+        "modelTemperatureCoverage_K": list(expected["temperatureCoverage_K"]),
+        "sourceValidityRange_K": None,
+        "validationStatus": expected["validationStatus"],
+        "fullTransientAdmitted": False,
+        "experimentalValidation": False,
+    }
+

+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid serialized {name} JSON") from error

+            or hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest() != digest):
+        raise ValueError(f"Serialized {name} binding changed")
+    return parsed

"""One real CPU/CUDA archive readback; no experimental or speedup claim."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import subprocess
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "python"))
from lpbf_gpu_thermal import enforce_gpu_pilot_result, run_queued_pilot, PARITY_TARGETS
from lpbf_gpu_pilot_artifacts import read_pilot_artifacts
from lpbf_gpu_pilot_numerics import validate_pilot_numerics
from lpbf_simulation import implementation_fingerprint, IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE_FILES

FOLDER = ROOT / "docs" / "LPBF_GPU_BOUND_ARCHIVE_ACCEPTANCE_2026-09-27"
REPORT = ROOT / "docs" / "LPBF_GPU_BOUND_ARCHIVE_ACCEPTANCE_2026-09-27.json"
CASE = {"jobType": "gpu-thermal-pilot", "mode": "standard", "backend": "cuda:0",
        "material": "Inconel 718", "power_W": 60, "speed_mm_s": 1200,
        "mesh_um": 40, "maxDt_s": 2e-7, "preheat_C": 80,
        "layer_um": 80, "trackLength_um": 200, "cooling_s": 2e-5, "dwell_s": 0}


def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if REPORT.exists():
    raise ValueError("Acceptance report already exists; preserve prior evidence")
FOLDER.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
save(FOLDER / "input.json", CASE)
save(FOLDER / "capabilities.json", {"scope": "Explicit CUDA pilot; actual device evidence in result"})
before = implementation_fingerprint()
source_hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "python" / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                 for name in IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE_FILES}
head = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,
                      text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
source_patch = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "HEAD", "--",
                              *("python/" + name for name in IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE_FILES)],
                             cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
started = time.perf_counter()
result = run_queued_pilot(CASE, artifact_dir=FOLDER)
states = read_pilot_artifacts(FOLDER, result["gpuFieldArtifacts"])
proof = validate_pilot_numerics(result, states, PARITY_TARGETS)
enforce_gpu_pilot_result(result, artifact_dir=FOLDER)
with patch("lpbf_gpu_thermal.validate", side_effect=AssertionError("current input validation consulted")), \
     patch("lpbf_gpu_thermal.require_cuda", side_effect=AssertionError("current device consulted")), \
     patch("lpbf_gpu_thermal.implementation_fingerprint", side_effect=AssertionError("current implementation consulted")):
    enforce_gpu_pilot_result(result, artifact_dir=FOLDER)
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
after = implementation_fingerprint()
assert before == result["provenance"]["implementationHash"] == after
cpu_dt, gpu_dt = (states[name]["accepted_dt_s"] for name in ("cpu", "gpu"))
diagnostic = {"countsEqual": len(cpu_dt) == len(gpu_dt),
              "arrayEqual": bool(np.array_equal(cpu_dt, gpu_dt))}
if cpu_dt.shape == gpu_dt.shape:
    diagnostic["maximumAbsoluteDifference_s"] = float(np.max(np.abs(cpu_dt - gpu_dt)))
    diagnostic["maximumRelativeDifference"] = float(np.max(np.abs(cpu_dt - gpu_dt) / cpu_dt))
save(FOLDER / "result.json", result)
enforce_gpu_pilot_result(result, artifact_dir=FOLDER)
save(REPORT, {
    "schemaVersion": 1, "scope": "One same-model CPU/Torch CUDA archive integrity case",
    "experimentalValidation": False, "productionReady": False,
    "beforeImplementationHash": before, "afterImplementationHash": after,
    "executionHead": head, "implementationSourceHashes": source_hashes,
    "executionSourcePatch": source_patch,
    "numericValidatorSha256": hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "python/lpbf_gpu_pilot_numerics.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "artifactCodecSha256": hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "python/lpbf_gpu_pilot_artifacts.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "acceptanceRunnerSha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "acceptanceRunnerText": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
    "sameRunProof": proof, "acceptedTimestepDiagnostic": diagnostic,
    "wholeManifestFiles": len(result["artifacts"]),
    "wholeManifestBytes": sum(item["size_bytes"] for item in result["artifacts"]),
    "historicalRestoreWithoutCurrentValidationOrCuda": "pass",
    "wallSecondsIncludingProducerAndReadback": elapsed,
    "performanceEvidence": "Single acceptance duration only; not paired throughput or speedup evidence"})
print(json.dumps({"status": proof["status"], "files": len(result["artifacts"]),
                  "cells": result["discretization"]["cells"],
                  "steps": result["discretization"]["steps"], "wall_s": elapsed,
                  "implementationHash": before, "acceptedTimestepDiagnostic": diagnostic}))
